title: Simon's identity 4.11 via integral representations: T(g dη) − ∂T(gη) = −T(dg∧η)
statement:
Let P, k ∈ ℕ and let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set. Let T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U (k+1)) and let μ, μ' be measures on ℝ^P. Let ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_{k+1}(ℝ^P) and ξ' : ℝ^P → Λ_k(ℝ^P) take values in the continuous linear functionals on covectors (MultiVector). Assume:
- T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for all ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(U);
- ∂T(θ) = ∫ ξ'(x)(θ(x)) dμ'(x) for all θ ∈ 𝒟^k(U).
Let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞ and η ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Then, as real numbers (Bochner integrals, with no integrability assumed),
∫ g(x)·ξ(x)(dη(x)) dμ(x) − ∫ g(x)·ξ'(x)(η(x)) dμ'(x) = −∫ ξ(x)(alternatizeUncurryFin((Dg(x)).smulRight(η(x)))) dμ(x),
where dη = exteriorDerivative η and Dg(x) = fderiv ℝ g x. Informally: T(g dη) − ∂T(gη) = −T(dg∧η).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (k + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1), T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ θ : TestFormOn U k, T.boundary θ = ∫ x, ξ' x ((θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → ∫ x, g x * ξ x (exteriorDerivative (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ - ∫ x, g x * ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ' = -∫ x, ξ x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((fderiv ℝ g x).smulRight ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x))) ∂μ
